successCriteria.description: The `markAsRead` method in `NotificationService` calls `notificationRepo.updateStatus` with exactly two arguments: the notification `id` and `NotificationStatus.READ` — no third `readAt` argument is passed.

All existing unit tests in `tests/unit/modules/notification/notification.service.test.ts` pass without modification — specifically the `markAsRead` tests that assert `updateStatus` is called with exactly `('notif-001', NotificationStatus.READ)`.

constraints: The fix must not change the `INotificationRepository.updateStatus` interface signature — it already declares `readAt` as optional (`readAt?: Date | null`) and that signature is correct.
The fix must not change the `INotificationService.markAsRead` interface signature — it already declares `markAsRead(id: string): Promise<void>` and that signature is correct.
The fix must not alter any other method in `NotificationService` — only the `markAsRead` method's call to `updateStatus` is in scope.
outOfScope: Changing the `INotificationRepository.updateStatus` interface signature — it already correctly declares `readAt` as optional.
Adding or modifying any test files — the existing tests already encode the correct expected behavior.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The `markAsRead` implementation must call `notificationRepo.updateStatus(id, NotificationStatus.READ)` with exactly two arguments, matching the test expectations in `tests/unit/modules/notification/notification.service.test.ts` lines 259 and 277 which assert `toHaveBeenCalledWith('notif-001', NotificationStatus.READ)`.
